name: macOS keymaps (cmux, iTerm2)
description: Shortcuts that follow cmux or iTerm2 on macOS. cmux: ⌘D splits right, ⇧⌘D splits down, ⌥⌘ with an arrow moves between panes, ⌘N opens a workspace, ⌘T a tab, ⇧⌘P opens the palette, ⌘P jumps to a workspace and ⌘B the sidebar. iTerm2: ⌘↑ and ⌘↓ scroll one line, ⇧⌘↑ and ⇧⌘↓ select the previous and next block, ⌘N opens a workspace and ⌘T a tab. Off until you pick one in Settings → Keyboard.
